title: Frostpetal's Creeping Ice
story: Deep in the blue glacier, Frostpetal the Glacier Bloom is sealing a mine tunnel with ice that creeps forward 8 meters every hour. Three miners are trapped 96 meters down the tunnel, and the rescue sled travels 40 meters every hour from the entrance. Mr 6 must know whether the sled reaches them before the ice does.
question: How many hours does the ice take to seal all 96 meters of the tunnel?
hint: The ice covers the same 8 meters every hour. How many 8s make 96?
victory: Mr 6 proved the sled needed under three hours while the ice needed twelve, so the miners rode out laughing — and Frostpetal, out-scheduled, bloomed into a harmless ice flower.
imagePrompt: A crystalline flower-shaped ice monster spreading frost down a glowing blue mine tunnel while a numeral-six knight urges a rescue sled forward under lantern light.
